title: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement

messages.subject: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our current offer for your requirements, maintaining our commitment to supporting your business with top-quality service and our extensive product range.

For this offer, we quote a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To provide some background on our pricing calculations, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Renewal ctr:4600070620 – multi-year proposal for part:360020
messages.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

Thank you for your offer. You have said that only multi-year volume agreements change prices, so we propose a multi-year agreement. The attached term sheets commit 20000 pieces per year over 24 or 36 months, with 60 days payment as in the current contract ctr:4600070620. This gives you planned volume and less quoting effort.

The forecast for part:360020 increased by 4.2% (fc:360020@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.

Would a cheaper variant suit you better, for example a different packaging or call-off pattern? Please tell us which package you can sign.

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Renewal ctr:4600070620 – multi-year proposal for part:360020
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for proposing a multi-year agreement and sharing the forecasted volume increase. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. That does not change our position. 

For a 24-month contract with 60 days payment terms, we can offer a revised price of €4.91 per unit. To be clear, our offer provides a price of €4.91 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Our technical team will review your question regarding alternative packaging or call-off patterns to see if further efficiencies are possible. From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.26 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.08 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.05 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Ball bearing 6306 renewal – revised multi-year packages
messages.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

Thank you for your revised offer and for checking our data. We have moved our price in the attached term sheets. They keep the structure you offered: 20000 pieces per year over 24 months, or 36 months if a longer term helps your planning, both with 60 days payment as in ctr:4600070620. A fixed multi-year volume gives you planned production and less quoting work.

Thank you also for the cost-saving ideas. Could you send the full list, including the cheaper material grade and the tolerance option, with the technical details, so that our engineers can check them? Which of the attached packages can you sign?

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Ball bearing 6306 renewal – revised multi-year packages
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your revised offer; however, we are unable to accommodate a further price reduction and must maintain our offer at €4.91 per unit for the 24-month contract. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our Angebot remains valid for 7 days.

Under our offer, we quote a price of €4.91 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

You mentioned that a fixed multi-year volume reduces quoting work; please provide the specific figures quantifying these savings. We will compile the technical details regarding the alternative material grade and tolerance options and forward them to your engineering team for review. From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.26 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.08 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.05 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
